verdict.rationale: Vue is itself a developer library published as an official npm package (vue-gh-2), alongside first-party ecosystem libraries such as Vue Router and Pinia (vue-docs-7, vue-docs-8). Community reports confirm these official libraries work out of the box (vue-comm-9, vue-comm-13). However, nothing in the evidence describes official SDKs in the usual sense: there is no service API (the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path), no multi-language client libraries, and no SDK reference docs aimed at AI or agent workflows. missing for 10: documented official SDK reference pages, SDKs for multiple languages or runtimes, AI/agent-oriented SDK guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK-based building.
